price.label: low end of the 2024 average surgeon's fee for upper eyelid surgery and facial fat grafting, the lowest-priced face surgeries in the ASPS table (rhinoplasty starts at $7,500, neck lift at $7,500 and facelift at $12,000)
price.source: American Society of Plastic Surgeons, 2024 Procedural Statistics, average surgeon/physician fees

vol_source: DataForSEO, Google Ads search volume for Texas (searches naming Houston) and for Houston (near me searches), November 16, 2026
left_out: Left out to keep this conservative: Botox and med spa searches (“botox near me” in Houston, 1,900 a month; “botox houston heights”, 20; “med spa houston heights”, 10), because injectables are priced far below surgery; and searches Google counts as the same search as one already listed (“nose job houston”, “neck lift surgery houston”, “facial plastic surgery houston”, “chin augmentation houston”). Searches with no measurable volume, such as “deep plane facelift houston” and “hairline lowering houston”, are not listed.
